notes.title: Major update before the full release
notes.content:
[b]New content for this update:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 manual save slots
[*] Story content of 2 endings (newly painted)
[*] Skip the opening story function (in the upper right corner of the bedroom scene, you need to pass the opening story once to use)
[*] Better Japanese translation quality (thanks to ANK!)
[*] Offline play (First time playing require internet)
[/list]

[b]Improve:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now skip the read text manually and remove the auto skip read text feature
[*] Reduced the numerical of the game
[*] Add the left and right parts of the text dialog box and text color
[*] Cursor with shadow
[*] Fixed role face item display is incorrect
[*] Fixed role shadow display is incorrect
[*] Fixed role can't be upgraded
[*] Fixed the internal index of fruit or cake
[*] Fixed sound trouble
[*] Remove the "Coming soon" tips
[*] Fixed change scene background image flicker problem
[*] Fixed some text layout
[*] Fix a lot of small problems that we can't remember
[/list]

Thanks for you. If there are no major defects in this update, we will full release the game in a few days.
We welcome your feedback and will actively handle it.
Chinese players can join QQ group: 779327222.
English players can give feedback in the community, we will answer your questions the next day.
